name: bug
description: Something does not work as it should

name: enhancement
description: A new feature or a better way to do something

name: documentation
description: The docs are wrong, missing or unclear

name: question
description: A question (Discussions are often the better place)

name: dependencies
description: A library, action or image update (Dependabot)

name: needs-triage
description: New: nobody has looked at it yet

name: needs-info
description: Waiting for the reporter: version, steps, logs or diagnostics

name: confirmed
description: Reproduced, or clearly real: ready to be worked on

name: duplicate
description: Already reported (the comment links the first issue)

name: wontfix
description: Will not be changed (the comment says why)

name: good first issue
description: Small and well described: a good first contribution

name: help wanted
description: The maintainers would welcome a pull request

name: P0
description: Data loss, a security hole or AGOS down for everyone: now

name: P1
description: A main flow broken for many installs: next release

name: P2
description: Broken with a workaround, or a small group affected

name: P3
description: Minor: cosmetic, rare or nice to have

name: area/install
description: The installer, the hardware check, the first start

name: area/update
description: agos update, release channels, rollback, signatures

name: area/web
description: The web app (pages, buttons, screens)

name: area/core
description: The core service (API, data, rules, background work)

name: area/hermes
description: Hermes, the agents' engine, as AGOS uses it

name: area/sandbox
description: The agents' sandboxes, tools and walls between workspaces

name: area/channels
description: Telegram and the other chat channels

name: area/backup
description: Backups and restore

name: os/linux
description: Seen on Linux

name: os/macos
description: Seen on macOS (the Lima VM)

name: os/windows
description: Seen on Windows (WSL 2)

name: skip-changelog
description: PR: no CHANGELOG line needed (refactor, tests, CI)

name: coverage-exempt
description: PR: the diff-coverage gate is waived (the PR says why)

name: api-breaking
description: PR: changes the core API on purpose (web types regenerated)
